summary.text: Omnipresent Four Seas is Long Hair Ancestor's strongest refinement path killer move. Lang Ya land spirit unleashes it across Lang Ya blessed land by boiling the blessed land's sea and expending its seawater.

claims.text: During Heavenly Court’s assault on Lang Ya blessed land, Lang Ya land spirit answers Fang Yuan’s emergency call by boiling the blessed land’s sea and forcing a grand immortal killer move onto every Heavenly Court Gu Immortal in range. Lang Ya land spirit names the move Omnipresent Four Seas: gains from when his main body, Long Hair Ancestor, killed a water path great expert, later comprehended as the strongest refinement path killer move. The move expends an immense amount of seawater, is normally reserved for refining rank eight Immortal Gu, and against these enemies can last only dozens of breaths.

Fang Yuan sees Lang Ya blessed land’s sea level fall as vast water maintains omnipresent four seas, and realizes the three continents float on seawater that is the blessed land’s refinement path foundation. The move can be contained in an area only if a matching immortal formation draws out its power to refine Gu; the Long Hair refinement path formation used to refine myriad self Immortal Gu for Fang Yuan is that formation. In this battle Lang Ya land spirit has no choice but to spread the move across the whole blessed land, so Fang Yuan’s super immortal formation would also be hit; the land spirit pulls Immortal Gu back into the silver giant and shelters the three races’ variant human Gu Immortals there. Fang Yuan notes that the move cannot differentiate friend and foe, so a free all-out attack from his side would not hold the upper hand.

Omnipresent four seas is in essence a refinement path killer move that uses Lang Ya blessed land’s refinement path dao marks and is the accumulation of Long Hair Ancestor’s entire life. It does not spare allies: Fang Yuan would be hit inside the range, but hairy men can move freely because they have refinement path dao marks naturally, and their refinement path killer moves are amplified to first rate rank eight power. Heavenly Giant Solor can also move freely while hairy man Gu Immortals control it, because that ancient battle formation depends on the user and becomes a refinement path giant in their hands; Fang Yuan and the other three races’ variant human Gu Immortals stay out of the attack for that reason. After more than ten breaths the seawater dries to an exposed seabed, Heavenly Court’s four immortals are still alive, and Fang Yuan warns that omnipresent four seas cannot last long enough to decide the fight alone.
